label: Bluesky
terms_note: Free, no review: app password (Settings › App passwords) → com.atproto.server.createSession → accessJwt / refreshJwt (or OAuth for AT Protocol clients); limits: 3,000 requests per 5 min per IP, createSession 300 per day per IP, repo writes 5,000 points/hour and 35,000/day per account (CREATE 3, UPDATE 2, DELETE 1 → max 1,666 creates/hour, 11,666/day); Bluesky Community Guidelines (labels for automated accounts, no spam).

auth: 1. Tenant creates an **app password** (Settings › Privacy and security › App passwords) — never the main password.
3. No developer registration, no app review.

endpoints.call: POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord` {repo: did, collection: `app.bsky.feed.post`, record{$type, text ≤ 300 graphemes, createdAt (ISO, trailing Z), langs[], facets[{index{byteStart,byteEnd}, feat
POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob` (raw bytes, ≤ 1 MB each, ≤ 4 per post) → `app.bsky.embed.images` with alt text

reference.limits: - 3,000 requests / 5 min per IP; `createSession` 300 / day per IP; repo writes 5,000 points/hour and 35,000/day per account (CREATE 3, UPDATE 2, DELETE 1 → ≤ 1,666 creates/hour, 11,666/day); `updateRepo` 2,600 / hour. - Free; Bluesky Community Guidelines (label automated accounts, no spam); links are nofollow.

fields.name: identifier
fields.help: Bluesky handle (e.g. alice.bsky.social) or the account's e-mail; sent as `identifier` to com.atproto.server.createSession.

fields.name: password
fields.help: An app password from Settings → Privacy and security → App Passwords, never the account password; the runtime exchanges it for a short-lived accessJwt (createSession is capped at 300/day per IP, so the token is cached and re-issued only on expiry or 401).

config_fields.name: did
config_fields.help: The account's DID (did:plc:..., shown in Settings → Account or returned by com.atproto.server.getSession); used as `repo` when writing records. The createRecord lexicon also accepts the handle here.

me.note: GET /xrpc/com.atproto.server.getSession (auth required) returns {handle, did, email?, emailConfirmed?, active?, status?} for the session's account. docs.bsky.app/docs/api/* now 301s to https://endpoints.bsky.app/; the lexicon JSON in the atproto repo is the authoritative definition.

publish_text.note: POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord {repo, collection: app.bsky.feed.post, record: {$type, text (<= 300 graphemes), createdAt}} returns {uri, cid}; the AT-URI is the post id used by read_comments / analytics_post (app.bsky.feed.post requires text and createdAt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/atproto/main/lexicons/app/bsky/feed/post.json; the runtime fills createdAt with the current UTC time). `reply_to` is ignored: a reply needs reply.root and reply.parent as {uri, cid} strong refs, and the parent's cid would have to be looked up first. No url / created_at in the response.

read_comments.note: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPostThread?uri=<at-uri> (depth default 6, parentHeight default 80 kept) returns {thread: threadViewPost {post, parent?, replies?}}; `comments` are the direct replies (each a threadViewPost whose `post` is a postView {uri, cid, author{did, handle}, record, indexedAt, ...}, deeper replies stay under raw.replies). page/limit are not sent: the thread comes back in one response. A reply that is a notFoundPost / blockedPost has no `post` and maps to an empty row.

read_mentions.note: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.notification.listNotifications?reasons=mention&limit=N (limit 1..100, default 50) returns {cursor, notifications[{uri, cid, author{did, handle}, reason, reasonSubject, record, isRead, indexedAt}]}; `reasons` is an array parameter sent as one value (mention), so replies / quotes are excluded. Pagination is cursor-based, so `page` and `since` are not sent.

analytics_post.note: GET /xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPosts?uris=<at-uri> (array parameter, up to 25; one value is sent) returns {posts[postView {uri, cid, author, record, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, indexedAt}]}; counts are mapped from posts[0]. The runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so counts are top-level fields (postView: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/atproto/main/lexicons/app/bsky/feed/defs.json).

not_offered.publish_image: Images must first be uploaded as raw bytes to POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob (<= 1 MB each) and embedded as app.bsky.embed.images; the runtime has no file upload.
not_offered.reply_comment: A reply is a createRecord whose record.reply carries root and parent strong refs {uri, cid}; the cid of the comment (and of the thread root) must be fetched first via getPosts / getPostThread, and the runtime cannot chain calls.
not_offered.delete: POST /xrpc/com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord needs {repo, collection, rkey}; the rkey is the last path segment of the post's AT-URI (at://did/app.bsky.feed.post/<rkey>) and the runtime has no expression to split it out of `post_id`.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluesky-social/atproto/main/lexicons/: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
